marketing_description: The Philips LED Filament Bulb, part number 573971, is a 5 W ST19 T19 shape bulb with an E26 medium base and a clear finish operating at 120 V. It provides 1400 lumens of warm white light at 2700 K with a 90 CRI, serving as a 75 W incandescent equivalent with a 300 degree beam angle, 15000 hour average life, and dimensions of 2-9/16 in diameter by 5-7/16 in length. Designed with features including energy efficient, long lasting, dimmable, smart compatible, easy to install, low maintenance, environmentally friendly, high quality, reliable performance, wide range of applications, compact design, and durable construction.
